groups.label: All seven
groups.description: Switch at the same moment. Today is the real shipped film; the others are drawn by the concept lab.

groups.label: Today vs my pick
groups.description: The shipped film against my current combination.

groups.label: Lower half
groups.description: Same camera; only what fills the lower band changes.

groups.label: Camera
groups.description: Steady look-ahead, the hand-held catch, and the camera reading the sections.

videos.label: Today (shipped)
videos.description: The real production film: current framing, rainbow bars, shake, colour split and flash.

videos.label: Ride first
videos.description: Nothing added. Closer, looking ahead and downhill toward the next landing.

videos.label: Catch
videos.description: Hits move the camera like a hand-held operator, with a short stamp at each contact; the six strongest hits flash.

videos.label: Score
videos.description: Upcoming hits slide toward the rider and fill as it lands. Black is drums; colour is voice or another instrument.

videos.label: Iris below
videos.description: The flowing contours you liked, with their real recent history, in the lower band.

videos.label: Sections
videos.description: The camera reads the song (wider when sparse, closer when dense) and the paper steps on each section downbeat.

videos.label: Together
videos.description: My combination: whole-course opening and ending, pencil to ink, catch with stamps, sections camera, Iris below.
